title: 第3章 十倍返现！疯狂消费一波
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“先生，您一共消费128。”

“看您是丸子的朋友，又是头一次来咱们店，这边给你抹个零，收您100。”老板笑着递来收款码。

“不用了，叔，你们做烧烤也不容易。”

江辰心里巴不得烧烤卖得再贵一些，不然，1000元的消费返现额度没法用完。

老板一听这话，眼底顿时多了几分欣赏。

这小伙子不占便宜，能处！

江辰扫码支付。

可紧接着，他就呆愣在原地。

支付成功后，系统的提示声并没有如期响起。

什么情况？

付完烧烤钱，存款就只剩下362块5毛8分！

下个月房租都危险了！

丸子二人走了过来，就看到江辰跟木头似的杵在原地。

“哥，你怎么了？别…别吓我啊！”丸子摇了摇江辰的手，后者毫无反应。

香菜伸手戳了戳江辰胸口：“卡了？”

就在这时！

【叮！检测到宿主为系统认证群体‘精神小妹’沈瑶（丸子）、夏梨（香菜）进行投资消费。】

【消费金额：128元（注：超出额度上限不返现）】

【触发十倍返现奖励！】

【返现结算中……128x10=1280元】

【奖励已到账，请宿主注意查收！】

江辰连忙掏出手机，一条银行短信紧随而至。

【您尾号为7268的储蓄卡账户，收入1280.00元，余额1642.58元。（XX银行）】

卧槽！真到账了！

“哈哈哈……”

江辰掩饰不住内心的狂喜。

丸子一头黑线：“哥，你...你没事吧？怎么突然傻笑起来了？”

江辰收敛神色，目光扫过二女。

嗯，财神爷无论从哪个角度看过去，都特养眼！

“走，哥带你们去购物！”江辰一脸豪气风发。

“购物？”

丸子愣了几秒，似是听到了一个很新鲜的词汇，随后搂住江辰的胳膊。

“哥，你也太好了叭！不仅请我们吃烧烤，还要带我们去购物！”

香菜洋溢着幸福的笑容，抱住江辰的另外一臂，“哥，你比我亲哥还亲！”

柔软而又真实的触感袭来。

江辰表面镇定，心里那叫一个暗爽！

似是想到什么，丸子突然贴近他的耳旁，“哥，你说的购物，该不会是要带我们去买......”

不怪她这么想，毕竟男人主动给女人花钱，无非就是为了那点事。

江辰闻言，当即翻起白眼：“在你眼里，哥难道是那种人？”

他长长叹了口气，走向门外。

香菜一脸不解地看向丸子：“丸子姐，你刚和哥说了什么？”

丸子轻轻戳了她鼻尖：“大人的事，小孩子少管！”

香菜低下头，小嘴嘟囔道：“小吗？不算小了吧...”

出了烧烤店，二女很自然地又往江辰身上黏。

江辰故作淡定，嘴角却是比AK还难压。

正所谓，饭饱思淫欲......

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Sir, you spent a total of 128."

"Seeing that you are a friend of Wanzi and it is your first time to come to our store, I will add a zero to you and charge you 100." The boss smiled and handed over the payment code.

"No, uncle, it's not easy for you to make barbecue."

Jiang Chen wished in his heart that the barbecue would be more expensive, otherwise, the 1,000 yuan consumption cashback quota would not be used up.

When the boss heard this, his eyes suddenly became more appreciative.

This young man doesn't take advantage, he can handle it!

Jiang Chen scanned the QR code to pay.

But then, he just froze in place.

After the payment was successful, the system prompt did not sound as expected.

What's going on?

After paying for the barbecue, the deposit was only 362 yuan, 50 cents and 8 cents!

Next month’s rent is in danger!

The two Wanzi walked over and saw Jiang Chen stuck in place like a piece of wood.

"Brother, what's wrong with you? Don't... don't scare me!" Wanzi shook Jiang Chen's hand, but the latter showed no reaction.

Xiangcai reached out and poked Jiang Chen's chest: "Is it stuck?"

Right now!

【bite!It was detected that the hosts were Shen Yao (Wanzi) and Xia Li (Xiancai) of the system-certified group's "spiritual girls" who were investing and consuming.】

[Consumption amount: 128 yuan (Note: No cash refund will be given if the amount exceeds the upper limit)]

[Trigger ten times cash back reward!】

[Cashback settlement in progress...128x10=1280 yuan]

[The reward has arrived, the host please pay attention to check it!】

Jiang Chen quickly took out his mobile phone, and a bank text message came right after him.

[Your savings card account ending in 7268 has an income of 1,280.00 yuan and a balance of 1,642.58 yuan.(XX Bank)]

Damn it!It’s really paid off!

"Hahaha..."

Jiang Chen couldn't hide the ecstasy in his heart.

Wanzi had a black line on his face: "Brother, are you...are you okay? Why did you suddenly giggle?"

Jiang Chen calmed down his expression and glanced at the two women.

Well, the God of Wealth is very eye-catching no matter which angle you look at it!

"Let's go, I'll take you shopping!" Jiang Chen looked proud.

"Shopping?"

Wanzi was stunned for a few seconds, as if he heard a very new word, and then he hugged Jiang Chen's arm.

"Brother, you are so kind! Not only did you treat us to a barbecue, but you also took us shopping!"

Xiangcai was filled with a happy smile and hugged Jiang Chen's other arm, "Brother, you are closer than my own brother!"

A soft and real touch came over me.

Jiang Chen looked calm on the surface, but felt secretly happy in his heart!

As if thinking of something, Wanzi suddenly leaned close to his ear, "Brother, when you talk about shopping, do you mean you want to take us shopping..."

Don't blame her for thinking so. After all, men take the initiative to spend money on women just for that reason.

When Jiang Chen heard this, he immediately rolled his eyes: "In your eyes, is that that kind of person I am?"

He let out a long sigh and walked toward the door.

Xiangcai looked at Wanzi with a puzzled face: "Sister Wanzi, what did you just say to me?"

Wanzi poked the tip of her nose gently: "Children, please stay out of adults' matters!"

Xiangcai lowered her head and murmured: "Is it small? Not too small..."

After leaving the barbecue restaurant, the two girls naturally clung to Jiang Chen again.

Jiang Chen pretended to be calm, but the corners of his mouth were harder to suppress than AK.

As the saying goes, when you are full, you will think about lust...
